items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: There was a guy like Lorenzo Lawson, he was a top tenor player in Detroit... I was gettin' around a little bit then

ctx.x: Paradise Valley was the name of...

That's just what the entertainers and musicians called it, "Paradise Valley", Like what it meant was when everybody got off of work, they all congregated at that block and everybody, you know, talked their thing and whatnot and so forth and so on.

So Kelly Martin, it was a 12-piece band, and Al McKibbon was in the band and Kelly was the leader and we had chorus girls and they'd bring that new act in every week, you know, and it was quite an experience for me. Course I could read, but it was a big town and then I began to hear guys.
